quest.title: Neko Is a Cat: Stone Human's Troubles
quest.description: Neko, "Provisional Head Priestess of the Asase Shrine," seems to have business with you...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Primogem x20, Mora x10000

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: "Celery"...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How's the statue?

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: That stone human is most skilled, meow meow meow.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is it done?

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: No, but before I knew it, he had brought a big, big stone over.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: He then started to knock on it, donk-donk-donk, all while muttering things about "employer" and "salary."

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, I would like to ask: what is an "envoyer," and what is "celery"?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I think you mean "employer" and "salary."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Basically, since you asked him to do something, he should be given something in return.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Ah, is that the case? So humans are particular about such things... Alright. I shall permit him to scratch my ears.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, Paimon doesn't think that's enough...

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Is it not? Hmm, then perhaps I should give him something to eat.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I think what he wants is Mora...

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Mora? Are these things not for shoving inside the Offering Box? How strange. To think that humans were concerned about such things.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, a salary is very important, actually.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Mmph. I will trust your words on account of the aid you've provided so far. I will speak to the stone human when we return.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: However, the stone human is no longer going donk-donk-donk. He seems to be carrying a short wooden pole, who knows what for...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A wooden pole? Isn't statue-carving done with a hammer, a chisel, and stuff like that?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Did his tools break or something...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Oh brother. Come on then, {NICKNAME}, let's go find Mr. Ooshima. Sounds like he needs some help!

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: *sigh* How am I supposed to work without a hammer or chisel...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Encountering some trouble?

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you. Well... I was careless. I didn't check my tools properly when we came here, so just as I was getting engrossed in my work, I broke my hammer and chisel by mistake...

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: I'd like to return to Narukami Island to buy some more, but...

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: How do I put this... I guess I'm just more used to finishing work like this in one go, you know?

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: My tools might be broken, but I can still do some measurements and figure out how I want to continue carving.

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: If I left now and went to Narukami Island to get some tools, I'd probably have to re-acquaint myself with the "feel" of this carving...

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: Also, this stone's composition is very hard. If we were to use ordinary tools, they would break pretty quickly.

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: Hmm, you know what...

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: Traveler, could you help me find 3 Iron Chunks?

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: I plan on making some tools personally, ones suited to the task.

response.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
response.text: Great! It's up to you, then.

choices.text: You're going to forge them yourself?

response.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
response.text: Come on, I'm someone who worked at Tatarasuna. Of course I know a thing or three about forging.

response.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
response.text: However, I probably shouldn't start any sort of furnace at the shrine. I imagine that the Lady Priestess would be displeased. It is a cat, after all.

response.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
response.text: Either way, please help me find 3 Iron Chunks.

talks.objective: Give Ooshima Junpei three Iron Ores
Give Ooshima Junpei three Iron Ores

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: Wonderful! These will do, I think.

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: I'll go find a suitable place outside to set a furnace up, and then I'll start making my tools.

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: Just let the Lady Priestess know, would you? I'll be packing up over here.

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: Meow meow meow. Is something the matter? Not to worry, I will prepare an adequate "celery."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, never mind. Basically, the stone human... Mr. Ooshima's tools are broken, but we gave him the materials he needs to repair 'em, so there shouldn't be any problem!

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: That is good. I look forward to seeing that stone, yes.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Hibiki said that once the stone in my likeness was made, some good thing might happen.

response.speaker: Neko
response.text: Ah, I am filled with expectation! What sort of good thing might happen? Perhaps Hibiki may even return...

choices.text: No, there aren't any issues. Things are going well.
How much is it going to be?

dialogues.speaker: Neko
dialogues.text: A "celery" is important to humans. I will remember that.

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: Hey there, have you secured the 3 Iron Chunks?
